title: #298 Popular Movies
prompt: Movies are popular all over the world. What is the cause of it？

promptSegments.text: Movies are popular all over the world.
What is the cause of it？

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Movies are popular because they provide great entertainment for people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Movies are popular because they provide great entertainment for people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Making movies easy for everyone to see helps keep the popularity of films.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Making movies easy for everyone to see helps keep the popularity of films.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that the main cause of movie popularity is the universal appeal of storytelling, and the solution is for cinemas to improve the viewing experience.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that the main cause of movie popularity is the universal appeal of storytelling, and the solution is for cinemas to improve the viewing experience.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay uses the PEEL structure in both body paragraphs, ensuring each body paragraph has exactly five sentences and follows the required academic starters.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay uses the PEEL structure in both body paragraphs, ensuring each body paragraph has exactly five sentences and follows the required academic starters.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of movie popularity is the universal appeal of compelling storytelling, which allows films to connect with diverse audiences regardless of location.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of movie popularity is the universal appeal of compelling storytelling, which allows films to connect with diverse audiences regardless of location.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A key solution to maintaining this popularity is the continuous innovation in cinematic technology, which enhances the viewing experience and keeps the industry fresh.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A key solution to maintaining this popularity is the continuous innovation in cinematic technology, which enhances the viewing experience and keeps the industry fresh.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.

modelPlan.focus: Analyze the global popularity of movies by examining key factors such as entertainment value, cultural influence, and technological advancements.
outline: Introduction: Present the universal appeal of movies and introduce the topic.
Body 1: Discuss the entertainment value and emotional connection movies provide.
Body 2: Explore the role of cultural influence and global marketing in movie popularity.
Conclusion: Summarize the main points and reflect on the future of movies as a global phenomenon.
keyArguments: Movies offer a universal form of entertainment that transcends cultural boundaries.
The film industry's ability to adapt to global markets and incorporate diverse cultural elements has contributed to its popularity.
